name: iterative_pareto_v1
description: Test set for the frame-count ↔ recall/CNPE Pareto sweep on the Iterative planner. Sessions were filtered from all annotated natural-cooking sessions by: (1) duration in [10, 30] min; (2) ≥ 5 annotated inventory items; (3) fraction of multi-use items (after > 0 in amount.txt) ≥ 0.80. Each session gives the reasoner real remaining-amount signal (not just 'fully consumed'), and enough items/duration for the loop's window-choice heuristic to matter.

core.description: Primary 5-session development set. Small enough to iterate on prompts in minutes; covers short/medium/long duration and varied item-count complexity. Start here.

sessions.note: Short, high-signal; Korean BBQ / rice — liquids (oil, soy, OJ) + bulk solids (cabbage, steak, rice, tofu) exercise both transparent and opaque windows.
Mid-length, 9 items, all multi-use. Dairy siblings (cheddar + sour cream) and liquid OJ stress derivative-vs-package detection.
Ground beef 51%-used + pasta + onion — strong dispensing signal for opaque packages; tomato (count=4→2) exercises count-unit logic.
11-item stress test. Mix of transparent (sour cream, ranch), opaque (ground beef, mixed nuts), and one single-use (salad 100% consumed) — good for testing given_up path.
Cross-participant generalization. Baking session (tart shell + dairy + sugar) — different kitchen layout, different cooking pattern.

extended.description: Additional 5 sessions for final evaluation once core tuning is stable. Gives a total n=10 so CNPE mean / recall are stable (~50–75 item predictions total). Run these only after prompts are frozen.

sessions.note: Breakfast: cottage cheese + milk + egg + bread + oatmeal. All multi-use, low-dispense-percentage (tests fine-grained fill-line reading).
Pasta-sauce stew. Three transparent liquids (pasta sauce, grape soda, sour cream) give dense transparent-window practice.
Longest session in set. Fewer items but long duration tests the planner's ability to pick sparse windows under frame budget pressure.
Lunch-scale session. 6 items, short; contrast anchor to the 20+ min long ones.
Second chaoyu session. Mushrooms + pepper + garlic + sausage — vegetable-heavy; tests bag-package reasoning.

usage.core_runtime_estimate: With max_rounds=6 and frame_budget=100, each session runs ~3-8 minutes end-to-end (1 planner call per round + 1 observer call per round). Core tier ~5 sessions × 5 min ≈ 25 min wall-clock per full sweep.
usage.extended_runtime_estimate: Extended tier adds another ~30-40 min. Full 10-session set ~1 hour per config.

sweep_configs_suggested.note: Low-frame anchor — tests whether 3 well-chosen windows beat the single-shot CandList baseline.
High-frame anchor — closer to PerItem's recall side; tests diminishing returns.

metrics: total VLM input+output tokens (planner + observer summed)
total observer frames sent (frame budget utilization)
recall (fraction of GT-annotated items with a prediction)
CNPE (mean weight-error / package-capacity over predicted items)
